rationale: C13 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. It frames continuity in government as dependent on a strong, competent, well-trained career service; identifies the need for a systematic program for selecting and developing top civilian career employees; assigns the President's personnel adviser to develop a program; and specifies cooperation with the Civil Service Commission and executive agencies. The child closely reproduces this rationale, vocabulary, and assignment structure while broadening the contemplated program. C11 and C22 contain closely related operative machinery, but their executive-order structures are less similar to the child's personalized memorandum.

shared_material.child_excerpt: both must have an adequate and continuing supply of well-trained and competent leaders and managers
shared_material.parent_excerpt: continuity in the administration of Government functions depends on a strong career service. It is increasingly essential ... that our career personnel be competent, well trained and nonpartisan
shared_material.explanation: Both use the need for continuity and competent, well-trained career personnel as the central justification.

shared_material.child_excerpt: a sound program for the selection, development and training of its career civil servants
shared_material.parent_excerpt: a systematic program for selecting, developing and making more effective use of its top level civilian career employees
shared_material.explanation: This is distinctive, materially overlapping language describing nearly the same personnel-development program.

shared_material.child_excerpt: as my Special Assistant for Personnel Management, you will take the leadership in the development of a government-wide program
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I request that you develop for early consideration a program of action
shared_material.explanation: Both directly assign the presidential personnel adviser responsibility for developing the contemplated program.

shared_material.child_excerpt: you will, of course, cooperate with and depend upon the Civil Service Commission ... you will cooperate with the heads of the agencies concerned
shared_material.parent_excerpt: you will work with the Civil Service Commission and the Bureau of the Budget to develop plans ... I am asking all of the departments and agencies ... to cooperate with you in the development of a program
shared_material.explanation: The same interagency implementation arrangement accompanies the substantive assignment.
